risks: Community test patterns may not match Format Factory's evidence standards

recommendations.activation_path: Skills normalization required: local wrapper → allowed_files (src/ read-only) → forbidden_files (no src/ write) → validation_command → evidence_rule → skill-registry.yaml entry

Pattern quality depends on community skill version — not pinned
recommendations.mitigation: Pin skill version in local wrapper; test on fods src/ before enabling for other formats

risks: Workflow tracer may execute format code — must be sandboxed
